objective: 최신 main 기준 실제 플레이, 문제 수정, 테마별 동일 기준 평가, 평균 90점 이상

scoring.kind: evidence-backed reviewer assessment, not a measured player satisfaction score
rules: Use the same dimensions and weights before and after fixes.
Score only after the listed representative cases have evidence; untested themes remain null.
Behavior: the intended player action reaches its result without a blocker or extra workaround.
Clarity: current state, available action, result and next step are readable at desktop and phone sizes.
Feel: feedback, pacing and visual consistency assessed during play, with explicit subjective limitations.
Robustness: cancellation, retry, reload, old-save and boundary cases preserve items and progress.
Cost: no avoidable repeated input or observable stalls; performance claims require measurements.
The final average requires all six themes, no known progress/data-loss blocker, and final regression checks.
Early-game or synthetic-fixture results cannot establish late-loop balance or player enjoyment.

themes.name: UI·가시성
themes.evidence: Actual desktop/390px equipment, skill gems, passive confirmation and stump controls; both breakpoint directions, closed-window state, maximize/restore and Escape; natural story and death reports; combat log height 336px to 27.2px when collapsed. Recommendation labels checked with nine real fixture items (two survival improvements).
themes.deductions: Some long item/support labels truncate at narrow widths; the full tree and dense crafting panels still require deliberate scrolling. This is a reviewer assessment, not a player usability survey.

themes.name: 안정성·성능
cases: measured busy combat and window interaction
themes.evidence: Fresh warrior/archer sessions and guest reload at level 29 after Act 10; real combat resumed in Chaos 1 with the equipped skill. Current full smoke, architecture, CSS and build checks plus legal-build save round trips. Ten-second browser combat samples, separate offline replay and stall timing reports. No errors/warnings in the resumed natural session; the isolated fixture intentionally omits Supabase.
themes.deductions: Desktop hardware only; no physical low-end phone or exhaustive worst-case render-load coverage. Three-minute endgame offline replay took about 6.1 seconds in Node with yielding; elapsed time is not a browser frame-time guarantee.

sessions.observed: guest creation, story, first gem equipped, first passive spent, act 1 boss killed, reward weapon chosen, automatic act 2 and act 3 progression, guest reload; desktop and 390x844 phone

sessions.mode: fresh guest; x8 dev speed for repeat verification; x1 during Act 10 and after reload; no granted levels/items/invulnerability
sessions.observed: Phone class confirmation, story geometry, first auto-equipped shield guide, passive preview/confirmation/cancel. Natural drops and earned passive points progressed through all ten acts. Act 4 and Act 9 deaths used automatic retreat and retry; selected a DPS upgrade, a balanced armor upgrade, and earned passive paths. Act 10 boss cleared at level 29 at x1; guest reload preserved level/progression and resumed real Chaos 1 combat. This single route is not optimized-build or all-class balance evidence.

sessions.mode: isolated in-memory, high-power navigation fixture; not balance evidence; commerce uses real wall-clock time
sessions.observed: Selected an inventory item, previewed slot 2 without removing it, confirmed listing, repriced first-contract unique from 8 to 1 magic bud; several named visitors left before a visitor purchased it. Sale freed the slot, recorded the item/price and paid exactly 1 bud; collection cleared proceeds and disabled the collect button. A separate expensive rare listing remains pending; no browser offer claim yet.

sessions.mode: versioned selected T14 and crafted T15 snapshots; separate from natural progression
sessions.observed: Atlas map selection/entry and actual crafted-build combat, desktop/phone window transitions, skill-gem and equipment screens, stump starter gifts, placement and retrieval. Stump growth/resonance/save behavior additionally checked by real-domain smoke tests; the short UI visit itself did not mature a seed.

findings.problem: Mobile selected equipment/map tab remained aria-pressed=false after desktop-to-phone resize.
findings.state: fixed; Node regression and actual phone tab switch verified

findings.problem: First-gear notice with auto-equipped loot and an empty inventory opened whichever mobile pane was previously selected, normally an empty inventory.
findings.state: fixed; Node regression and fresh archer first-shield guide opening the loadout verified

findings.problem: Story image width:100% plus border exceeded the mobile content box and created a horizontal scrollbar.
findings.state: fixed; actual 390px phone image/body widths both 308.8px and scrollWidth/clientWidth both 309

findings.problem: Desktop dialog role and label reference survived removal of the title bar on mobile.
findings.state: fixed; actual desktop-to-phone round trip removed role, aria-labelledby and tabindex

findings.problem: Passive confirmation re-hit-tested a touch-selected node using the smaller mouse radius; phone-layout mouse clicks also spent immediately and left stale confirmation details.
findings.state: fixed; regression failed before the fix and passed after it. Real phone preview and confirmation, cancellation, desktop single-click allocation and responsive round trip verified.

findings.problem: No balanced recommendation was described as no better equipment even when attack-only or defense-only upgrades existed.
findings.state: fixed; labels distinguish balanced, attack and survival results without changing ranking. Real nine-item analysis showed balanced zero and survival two with the corrected balanced-none label.

findings.problem: Returning from phone restored an older desktop window instead of the selected panel; shrinking a closed desktop window resurrected its stale active tab.
findings.state: fixed in both directions. Failing-then-passing regression uses the actual window manager and tab controller. Browser verified skills remain open/focused when enlarged and a closed items window stays closed when shrinking; ordinary desktop resize does not reopen windows.

findings.problem: Stump starter gift said one per color, but the documented rule grants one seed and one sap with a chosen color.
findings.state: corrected wording to 씨앗·수액 각 1개; no reward changes. Actual desktop/390px view and existing starter/placement/save smoke verified.

findings.problem: Rebuilding desktop chrome after phone mode added another panel click listener, so one maximize click toggled twice and appeared broken.
findings.state: panel input now binds once; rebuilt title bars retain their own handlers. Failing-then-passing regression and actual false/true/false maximize state sequence verified after a breakpoint round trip.

browserCombat.scenario: Crafted T15 warrior in an actual Atlas bark-fissure map, 1280x720, ten seconds per sample on this desktop
browserCombat.limitation: Samples are not worst-case, all-class or mobile hardware guarantees; four-speed affects combat, not stall settlement.

stallNode.limitation: Warm Node domain timings exclude rendering.

offlineReplay.limitation: Synthetic load fixtures, not legal-build balance evidence; runtime/save restoration assertions passed.

legalBuildCombat.validation: Current equipment requirements, connected allocated passives, level-earned point budget and save round-trip stats checked for selected T14 and crafted T15 builds.
legalBuildCombat.result: With unchanged crafted gear, Chaos 20 boss clears rose from 3.6–3.8 seconds at loop 10 to 39.9–40.7 seconds at loop 50. The weaker T14 build failed this boss but cleared the Act 10 boss.
legalBuildCombat.limitation: Direct encounters bypass destination gates; same gear across loops with no additional permanent growth. Not normal-player target times or all-class balance.

validation.baseline: 281/283; two failures were missing private local art, not runtime failures. Restored ignored art from existing rignin-next per publish document; both failed checks then passed.
validation.targeted: smoke-playtest-navigation, smoke-passive-selection-input, smoke-notice-battle-flow, smoke-ui-layout-state (including actual navigation integration), smoke-review5-fixes, smoke-equipment-triage, smoke-stump-box and smoke-stump-box-ui passed
validation.finalSuite: 285/285 passed in 42.1 seconds after the final runtime change (artifacts/main-playtest/final-followup-tests.log); architecture, CSS and build checks passed. Browser error/warning logs empty after the level-29 guest reload; isolated fixture has no error logs.
validation.screenshots: artifacts/main-playtest (local ignored evidence; not public private-art distribution)

remaining: Four themes remain unscored: verify representative movement-skill/summon combat, advancement and endgame unlock flows, later destination navigation, direct chest/breakable outcomes, and browser offer negotiation. Natural Act 1–10 progression and two controlled late builds are now covered, but do not establish all-class balance. UI/stability scores are reviewer assessments; no six-theme average or overall 90-point claim yet.
